method_limitations: This scanner applies three syntactic heuristics (count mismatch, status mismatch, boolean mismatch) over structured key-value lines, bold patterns, and table rows in Markdown artifacts. It is an UPPER BOUND estimator: (1) false positives occur when different entities share the same key name across artifacts; (2) false negatives occur for contradictions expressed in unstructured prose, multi-sentence reasoning, or non-adjacent pipeline stages. The output contradiction_rate_per_run is not a true precision-recall metric and must be interpreted as a detection signal, not a ground truth. Manual verification of the precision sample is required to calibrate the signal.
